title: Migrate Inventory Group Between AAP Inventories
description: Migrate an inventory group, including its description, variables, associated hosts, and child subgroups, from a source AAP inventory to a target AAP inventory, then delete the old group structure from the source inventory while keeping its hosts.

playbook_input.description: Parameters the caller provides before execution

parameters.name: source_inventory
parameters.description: Name of the source AAP inventory (Inventory A) containing the group to migrate.

parameters.name: target_inventory
parameters.description: Name of the target AAP inventory (Inventory B) where the group will be created.

parameters.name: group_name
parameters.description: Name of the group to migrate from the source inventory to the target inventory.

parameters.name: aap_gateway_ip
parameters.description: Hostname or IP address of the AAP controller gateway.

parameters.name: aap_username
parameters.description: Username for authenticating to the AAP controller.

parameters.name: aap_password
parameters.description: Password for authenticating to the AAP controller.

parameters.name: aap_validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when connecting to the AAP controller. Defaults to false for self-signed certificates.

playbook_output.description: Emits group_name, source_inventory, target_inventory, migrated_hosts, migrated_children, and a status message.

fields.name: source_inventory
fields.description: Name of the source inventory the group was migrated from.

fields.name: target_inventory
fields.description: Name of the target inventory the group was migrated to.

fields.name: migrated_hosts
fields.description: List of host names associated with the migrated group.

fields.name: migrated_children
fields.description: List of child subgroup names associated with the migrated group.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Status message indicating the migration result.

steps.name: Look up source group details
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API for the source group by name within the source inventory, recording its name, description, variables, and id.

steps.name: Does the source group exist?
steps.function: Branch on whether step-01's lookup found exactly one matching source group.
steps.condition: The source group lookup returned exactly one matching group.

steps.name: Look up source group hosts
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API for the hosts associated with the source group, recording the associated host names.

steps.name: Look up source group child subgroups
steps.function: Query the AAP controller API for the child subgroups nested inside the source group, recording the child subgroup names.

steps.name: Normalize group variables to a dict
steps.function: Convert the source group's variables field from a YAML/JSON string into a dict for use when creating the target group.

computations._group_variables: Parse _source_group.variables from a YAML/JSON string into a dict; if empty or null, use an empty dict.

steps.name: Ensure hosts exist in target inventory
steps.function: Ensure each host associated with the source group exists in the target inventory, so they can be associated with the new group.

steps.name: Create group in target inventory
steps.function: Create the group in the target inventory with the same name, description, and variables from the source group, and associate the source group's hosts and child subgroups with the new group.

steps.name: Delete old group structure from source inventory
steps.function: Delete the old group and its subgroup structure from the source inventory while keeping the underlying hosts in the source inventory.

steps.name: Emit result block
steps.function: Print the Required Output Format <result> block on success.

steps.name: Emit error and fail
steps.function: Reached via the playbook's rescue block on any task failure. Prints the Required Error Output Format block and fails the play.

phases.name: Pre-checks
phases.description: Look up the source group, its hosts, and child subgroups, and validate the group exists before migrating.

phases.name: Main action
phases.description: Ensure hosts exist in the target inventory, create the migrated group, and delete the old group structure from the source inventory.

phases.name: Reporting
phases.description: Emit the structured final result to the caller.

phases.name: Error handling
phases.description: Reached when any step fails; records failure and halts execution.
